# v0.10.0b4 — Cost target and waiting stops

- New: **Cost target** limits a charge by an amount of money. The service keeps the amount with the energy target that carries it, books the energy at each price and stops the charge itself, also while Home Assistant is down; Home Assistant only tells it the current price. It needs configured charging costs; setting the energy target by hand ends it. An estimate, not for billing.
- A waiting pause, lock or withdrawn release is kept against every command except the one that overrides it; a start refused behind a waiting lock is now reported.
- A lock or withdrawn release whose reply did not come is written again after five seconds instead of after a whole state-change interval.
- Smaller fixes: repairs of a disabled, never set-up entry are removed; app page refusals carry security headers; a refused write no longer delays the next request; clearer message for a command that may not have been saved.

Update the app and the integration to **0.10.0b4** together. The cost target is not yet tested on real hardware.

Every contribution is voluntary and very welcome; support and new features stay open to everyone either way.
